name: Gold Pocket Watch
description: A tarnished gold pocket watch. The engraving on the back reads: 'To E.H. — Time reveals all.' The hands are stopped at 11:47.

name: Torn Note
description: Half a page torn from a letter. The visible text reads: '...meet me Thursday at the old mill. Come alone. Tell no one, especially not H...' The rest is missing.

name: Iron Key
description: A heavy iron key with a worn bow. A small tag reads '3' in faded ink.

name: Calling Card
description: A cream-coloured card. 'Mr. R. Harlow — Solicitor. 14 Marsh Street.' The corner is slightly singed.
